tess: quick notes from Cartographer13B int4 bring-up. hitting intermittent OOMs during long-context QA jobs (~5k tokens) on canary. kernel shows prefetched KV allocations failing.
omar: can you paste the short error?
tess: ```[2025-10-10T11:02:03Z] CUDA OOM: alloc 900 MiB failed; used=49.8 GiB free=0.7 GiB; context=kv_prefetch_alloc(2048)```
li: free=0.7 GiB screams fragmentation. allocator=jemalloc on these nodes?
tess: yes, jemalloc arenas=6.
sanjay: three low-risk mitigations to try on canary: 1) reduce default max_new_tokens 1200->600, 2) enable micro-batch split 4->2, 3) enable KV-trim-on-evict age=128 tokens.
omar: also try enabling jemalloc background purge on canary; small risk but useful for diagnosis.
tess: launched matrix: 
- A int4, max_new=600, split=2, kv_trim=128
- B int4, max_new=900, split=2, bg_purge=true
- C int8, max_new=1200 control
deploy-bot: canary deploy cartographer/int4-> carto-canary-1 SUCCESS
li: early 150-run results: A stable, p95 +20% latency, mem avg 46.9 GiB, rouge-L delta -0.7 on long prompts; B had 2 OOMs/150, mem 48.1 GiB; C stable mem 53.2 GiB quality -0.2.
sanjay: seems micro-splitting + lower max_new is the best low-cost tradeoff. propose preset cartographer13b.int4-conserve -> {max_new_tokens:600, micro_batch:2, kv_trim_age:128, jemalloc_bg_purge:true}.
omar: add route-level soft cap: unknown clients default to max_new=256 to reduce blast radius.
tess: filed PR #PR-1420 to update canary defaults and add preset; ops runbook link in PR. filed infra ticket INF-3499 for allocator/compaction research.
li: add perf counter kv_slots_per_request to telemetry so we can autotune trimming. small task.
tess: PR merged, canary at 6% traffic. dashboard snapshot: p99 1.1s, OOMs last 30m: 0, mem drift +0.15 GiB/hr.
sanjay: schedule 24h watch then expand. closing thread, action items in PR and INF-3499.
